candidate_generation.method: projected Euclidean distance to directed road segments
candidate_generation.fallback: nearest road segment when no segment intersects the search radius

reference_alignment.method: monotone Viterbi-style alignment of ordered route arcs to GPS observations
reference_alignment.low_confidence_target_behavior: reference candidate target is left blank when route alignment distance exceeds threshold
reference_alignment.caution: Derived alignment is an assumption; review route alignment distances and candidate misses.

feature_selection.scaling: none during feature generation; fit any scaler within each training fold

feature_rationales.projected_fraction: location along directed road segment from its start, from 0 to 1
feature_rationales.segment_length_m: length of the candidate segment in metres
feature_rationales.distance_to_start_m: GPS distance to the segment's start node in metres
feature_rationales.distance_to_end_m: GPS distance to the segment's end node in metres
feature_rationales.heading_cosine: alignment of GPS movement direction and directed segment orientation
feature_rationales.heading_available: whether a valid preceding GPS point supplies a movement direction
feature_rationales.gps_speed_mps: speed between consecutive GPS observations in metres per second
feature_rationales.time_gap_seconds: elapsed timestamp difference from the preceding observation
feature_rationales.candidate_rank: distance rank among the returned candidates
feature_rationales.candidate_count: number of candidates returned for this observation
feature_rationales.nearest_fallback_used: whether only the nearest segment was available outside the search radius
